current_work: Run `bash scripts/run-app.sh` from the branch checkout: it generates Folio.xcodeproj, builds the Folio Xcode target (the first compile of any App/ source), ad-hoc signs it outside the synced folder and launches it. Then walk the 16-item responsiveness checklist on the disposable FOLIO TEST project at wide, normal and smallest supported (1040x640) window sizes: Notes/Roadmap/Connections switching, resize-to-floor behaviour, Split in a normal window, typing in Split, and control hit-testing after resizing. Every item is unchecked until then, and live microphone/speech testing stays blocked until the UI is stable.
